**The design is fixed and all tests pass.**

I found and corrected two bugs in the traffic_light.v module:

1. **Line 27 - Pedestrian shortening condition**: Changed `timer == MAIN_GREEN_MIN - 1` to `timer >= MAIN_GREEN_MIN - 1`. This ensures that if a pedestrian request arrives late in the MG phase (after the timer has already passed the minimum threshold), MG still ends on the next cycle, as specified in the spec.

2. **Line 31 - SY phase duration**: Changed `MAIN_YELLOW_T - 1` to `SIDE_YELLOW_T - 1`. The SY (side yellow) phase must use its own timing parameter SIDE_YELLOW_T (default 3 cycles), not borrow the MAIN_YELLOW_T parameter (default 2 cycles).

The simulation now passes successfully.
